Welcome to the Marion County Recorder’s Office
Message from the Recorder:
Thank you for visiting the Marion County Recorder’s website.
I am working to include frequently asked questions and to give you some helpful information as I continue to expand this website.
You may call us if you have questions, and my staff will be happy to assist you. We cannot give legal advice, and it may be necessary for you to come to the office for us to assist you.
As your Marion County Recorder, it is my goal to help citizens understand the functions of the Recorder’s office and to provide the best possible customer service.
Sincerely,
Leslie A. Longstreth
Recorder

Due to the passage of SB 94 by the Ohio Legislature, recording fees for most documents will increase by $5.00 starting January 1, 2025.
This surcharge supports the preservation and digitization of documents, as well as ongoing costs incurred by the county recorder's office.
Please see Resources & Links under Related Pages for more information.
